journeys.name: portable-pipeline-execution
journeys.positiveProof: The same script hash executes after host bindings are supplied.
journeys.negativeProof: Import fails before mutation when a required connection or secret binding is absent.

journeys.name: connection-and-secret-rebinding
journeys.positiveProof: Explicit target bindings resolve every logical dependency without exporting secret material.
journeys.negativeProof: Unknown, duplicate, or colliding bindings fail validation without target mutation.

journeys.name: schedules-and-notifications
journeys.positiveProof: Schedules import disabled, then activate once after fencing and notification validation.
journeys.negativeProof: A stale scheduler lease or unresolved notification keeps imported jobs disabled.

journeys.name: quality-and-stewardship
journeys.positiveProof: Rule identities, counts-only evidence, ownership, and stewardship scores agree across surfaces.
journeys.negativeProof: Critical rule or required-tag failure returns a non-zero gate result.

journeys.name: report-publication
journeys.positiveProof: A validated report publishes with its logical folder and ownership metadata preserved.
journeys.negativeProof: Policy, permission, collision, or dataset-key failure prevents publication.

journeys.name: identity-and-ownership
journeys.positiveProof: Explicit identity mapping preserves catalog ownership under target organization policy.
journeys.negativeProof: Ambiguous or unmapped principals fail preflight without silently changing ownership.

journeys.name: backup-and-restore
journeys.positiveProof: A commit-bound restore point reconstructs the declared pre-cutover state.
journeys.negativeProof: Tampered, wrong-key, or incompatible backups fail before replacement.

journeys.name: environment-promotion
journeys.positiveProof: Repeated validated import converges without duplicate objects.
journeys.negativeProof: Collision and compatibility reports fail closed before cutover.

journeys.name: topology-growth
journeys.positiveProof: Single-node state migrates to shared stores and stale writers are fenced.
journeys.negativeProof: Missing shared storage, keys, affinity, or fencing prevents HA cutover.

journeys.name: n-to-n-plus-one-upgrade
journeys.positiveProof: Release N state migrates once and passes post-upgrade convergence checks.
journeys.negativeProof: Incompatible schema or failed migration restores the tested N restore point.

journeys.name: saas-import-and-export
journeys.positiveProof: Portable artifacts enter a disabled tenant boundary and export without host-owned material.
journeys.negativeProof: Tenant-id, root, namespace, quota, or binding collision prevents activation.

journeys.name: tenant-isolation-and-failure-containment
journeys.positiveProof: Concurrent tenants remain disjoint across data, execution, observability, support, and quota boundaries.
journeys.negativeProof: Cross-tenant reads, writes, cache reuse, queue delivery, support access, and quota overflow are denied and audited.
